# BoseUI — LLM & AI Assistant Documentation Index

> Modern React components built with Framer Motion, Tailwind CSS, and TypeScript.
> Crafted by Rishabh Bose (https://theb0se.vercel.app/)

## Overview
- **Library**: BoseUI
- **Website**: https://boseui.site
- **Author**: Rishabh Bose — GitHub: https://github.com/Theb0se | LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/rishabhbose3107/
- **Stack**: Next.js (App Router), React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion
- **Registry Index**: https://boseui.site/registry.json

## Available Kinetic Components (40)

### Accordion Stack Cards (`AccordionStackCards`)
- **Slug**: `accordion-stack-cards`
- **Category**: Cards
- **Tagline**: Spatial 3D card deck with hover cascade and spring cycling.
- **Description**: Spatial 3D card deck that fans out into a vertical cascade on pointer hover or focus and cycles card order with spring layout projection.
- **Docs URL**: https://boseui.site/components/accordion-stack-cards
- **shadcn CLI Install**: `npx shadcn@latest add https://boseui.site/r/accordion-stack-cards.json`
- **Registry Manifest**: https://boseui.site/r/accordion-stack-cards.json
- **Key Features**:
  - Depth-scaled 3D card stack that smoothly fans out into an inspectable vertical cascade on hover or keyboard focus.
  - Click or press Enter/Space on any card to cycle the front card to the back with Hooke's Law layout springs.
  - Zero external dependencies beyond Framer Motion and Lucide icons.
- **Accessibility**:
  - Each card is keyboard-focusable and automatically expands the stack when focused via Tab.
  - Supports Enter and Space keys to cycle cards through the deck.
  - Disables scale depth transformations when prefers-reduced-motion is enabled.
- **Props**:
  - `items` (StackCardItem[]): Array of card items containing id, badge, title, metric, and subtitle.
  - `stiffness` (number, default: 300): Spring stiffness coefficient for deck expansion and card cycling.
  - `damping` (number, default: 25): Spring damping coefficient controlling stack oscillation decay.
- **Usage Example**:
```tsx
import { AccordionStackCards } from "@/components/ui/accordion-stack-cards";

export function Example() {
  return (
    <AccordionStackCards stiffness={300} damping={25} />
  );
}
```

### Aurora Flux Surface (`AuroraFluxSurface`)
- **Slug**: `aurora-flux-surface`
- **Category**: Backgrounds
- **Tagline**: Dual-mass GPU radial aurora surface with zero React re-renders.
- **Description**: GPU-composited ambient aurora canvas where dual radial luminance fields with contrasting spring mass chase the pointer.
- **Docs URL**: https://boseui.site/components/aurora-flux-surface
- **shadcn CLI Install**: `npx shadcn@latest add https://boseui.site/r/aurora-flux-surface.json`
- **Registry Manifest**: https://boseui.site/r/aurora-flux-surface.json
- **Key Features**:
  - Pairs a low-mass leading radial orb (m=0.4) with a high-mass trailing orb (m=1.4) for organic fluidseparation.
  - Composited directly via Framer Motion useMotionTemplate with zero React state re-renders.
  - Monochrome architectural dot overlay preserving BoseUI's high-contrast aesthetic.
- **Accessibility**:
  - Marks all ambient luminance and dot texture layers with aria-hidden='true'.
  - Freezes luminance orb coordinates when prefers-reduced-motion is active.
  - Preserves WCAG AA contrast inside the foreground container.
- **Props**:
  - `orbRadius` (number, default: 260): Radius of the primary radial luminance field in pixels.
  - `stiffness` (number, default: 180): Spring stiffness coefficient for the leading luminance orb.
  - `damping` (number, default: 24): Spring damping coefficient controlling luminance trail decay.
- **Usage Example**:
```tsx
import { AuroraFluxSurface } from "@/components/ui/aurora-flux-surface";

export function Example() {
  return (
    <AuroraFluxSurface orbRadius={260} stiffness={180} damping={24} />
  );
}
```

### Cipher Scramble Text (`CipherScrambleText`)
- **Slug**: `cipher-scramble-text`
- **Category**: Text
- **Tagline**: Cryptographic glyph permutation wave with screen-reader safety.
- **Description**: Cryptographic matrix text decoder that permutes characters through a high-frequency glyph wave on pointer hover, focus, or click.
- **Docs URL**: https://boseui.site/components/cipher-scramble-text
- **shadcn CLI Install**: `npx shadcn@latest add https://boseui.site/r/cipher-scramble-text.json`
- **Registry Manifest**: https://boseui.site/r/cipher-scramble-text.json
- **Key Features**:
  - Progressive left-to-right cryptographic character lock-in with customizable glyph pool and frame cadence.
  - Triggers seamlessly on pointer hover, keyboard focus, or tactile click.
  - Pairs an sr-only canonical string with an aria-hidden visual stream so screen readers never read scrambled noise.
- **Accessibility**:
  - Exposes the decoded canonical string inside an sr-only node while marking the permuting glyph stream aria-hidden='true'.
  - Fully keyboard-triggerable via Tab focus or Enter/Space activation.
  - Bypasses character scrambling immediately when prefers-reduced-motion is enabled.
- **Props**:
  - `text` (string, default: "ZERO-DEPENDENCY KINETIC PRIMITIVES"): Target decoded text string.
  - `charset` (string, default: "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789#$%&*+<>?"): Pool of cipher characters sampled during scramble frames.
  - `frameInterval` (number, default: 28): Duration of each scramble frame tick in milliseconds.
  - `cyclesPerChar` (number, default: 2): Number of scramble ticks per character before locking into place.
- **Usage Example**:
```tsx
import { CipherScrambleText } from "@/components/ui/cipher-scramble-text";

export function Example() {
  return (
    <CipherScrambleText
      text="ZERO-DEPENDENCY KINETIC PRIMITIVES"
      frameInterval={28}
      cyclesPerChar={2}
    />
  );
}
```

### Constellation Mesh Field (`ConstellationMeshField`)
- **Slug**: `constellation-mesh-field`
- **Category**: Backgrounds
- **Tagline**: Interactive SVG constellation graph with pointer proximity edges.
- **Description**: Interactive SVG vertex constellation surface that dynamically tethers proximity edges to the pointer with spring-scaled nodes.
- **Docs URL**: https://boseui.site/components/constellation-mesh-field
- **shadcn CLI Install**: `npx shadcn@latest add https://boseui.site/r/constellation-mesh-field.json`
- **Registry Manifest**: https://boseui.site/r/constellation-mesh-field.json
- **Key Features**:
  - Crisp vector SVG constellation lattice that scales cleanly to any container resolution.
  - Real-time Euclidean distance culling that draws opacity-graded edges between the pointer and nearby vertices.
  - Spring-inflated vertex radii when captured within the pointer's connection radius.
- **Accessibility**:
  - Decorative SVG graph layer is marked aria-hidden='true'.
  - Disables dynamic edge tethering when prefers-reduced-motion is enabled.
  - Maintains high foreground text contrast inside a translucent HUD card.
- **Props**:
  - `connectRadius` (number, default: 130): Maximum Euclidean distance in viewBox units to connect pointer edges.
  - `children` (React.ReactNode): Optional foreground content rendered above the constellation mesh.
- **Usage Example**:
```tsx
import { ConstellationMeshField } from "@/components/ui/constellation-mesh-field";

export function Example() {
  return (
    <ConstellationMeshField connectRadius={130} />
  );
}
```

### Cursor Follower (`CursorFollower`)
- **Slug**: `cursor-follower`
- **Category**: Motion
- **Tagline**: Coupled dual-spring pointer follower with declarative HUD labels.
- **Description**: Dual-spring custom pointer stage with a high-stiffness inner core and morphing outer ring that expands into contextual HUD pills.
- **Docs URL**: https://boseui.site/components/cursor-follower
- **shadcn CLI Install**: `npx shadcn@latest add https://boseui.site/r/cursor-follower.json`
- **Registry Manifest**: https://boseui.site/r/cursor-follower.json
- **Key Features**:
  - High-stiffness inner core dot paired with a damped trailing outer ring.
  - Declarative contextual label morphing via the data-cursor-label HTML attribute.
  - Built-in live X/Y coordinate telemetry HUD in the stage corner.
- **Accessibility**:
  - Automatically restores native OS pointer and hides custom follower rings when prefers-reduced-motion is enabled.
  - Follower layers use pointer-events-none so underlying buttons and links remain 100% clickable.
  - Decorative follower elements are hidden from screen readers via aria-hidden='true'.
- **Props**:
  - `accentColor` (string, default: undefined): Optional hex or CSS color override applied to the inner core dot and trailing ring border.
  - `ringStiffness` (number, default: 260): Spring stiffness of the trailing outer ring.
  - `ringDamping` (number, default: 22): Spring damping of the trailing outer ring.
  - `ringSize` (number, default: 34): Idle diameter in pixels of the outer ring.
  - `showCoordinates` (boolean, default: true): Displays a live X/Y coordinate telemetry badge in the top-right corner.
- **Usage Example**:
```tsx
import { CursorFollower } from "@/components/ui/cursor-follower";

export function Example() {
  return (
    <CursorFollower className="p-8">
      <div data-cursor-label="OPEN PROJECT ↗" className="rounded-xl border p-6">
        Hover me to morph the trailing cursor ring into a HUD pill.
      </div>
    </CursorFollower>
  );
}
```

### Dynamic Island Toast (`DynamicIslandToast`)
- **Slug**: `dynamic-island-toast`
- **Category**: Overlays
- **Tagline**: Three-stage morphing status capsule with spring layout projection.
- **Description**: Morphing top-edge status capsule that expands smoothly between compact badge, live telemetry pill, and actionable notification drawer.
- **Docs URL**: https://boseui.site/components/dynamic-island-toast
- **shadcn CLI Install**: `npx shadcn@latest add https://boseui.site/r/dynamic-island-toast.json`
- **Registry Manifest**: https://boseui.site/r/dynamic-island-toast.json
- **Key Features**:
  - Three-state layout projection (compact -> telemetry -> expanded) driven by Hooke's Law spring geometry.
  - Click directly on the capsule or use external state triggers to morph dimensions and border radii seamlessly.
  - Includes interactive collapse and dismiss actions inside the expanded notification card.
- **Accessibility**:
  - Uses role='status' and aria-live='polite' to announce live notification state transitions.
  - All interactive stages and collapse buttons are keyboard-focusable via Tab and Enter/Space.
  - Collapses transition duration to near-zero when prefers-reduced-motion is enabled.
- **Props**:
  - `defaultMode` ("compact" | "telemetry" | "expanded", default: "compact"): Initial visual state of the morphing status island.
  - `title` (string, default: "Registry Sync Active"): Primary notification heading displayed in telemetry and expanded modes.
  - `subtitle` (string, default: "12 shadcn v2 manifests compiled in 42ms"): Detailed status description displayed in expanded mode.
  - `stiffness` (number, default: 340): Hooke's Law spring stiffness for capsule dimension morphing.
  - `damping` (number, default: 25): Spring damping coefficient controlling capsule oscillation decay.
- **Usage Example**:
```tsx
import { DynamicIslandToast } from "@/components/ui/dynamic-island-toast";

export function Example() {
  return (
    <DynamicIslandToast
      defaultMode="compact"
      title="Registry Sync Active"
      subtitle="12 shadcn v2 manifests compiled in 42ms"
    />
  );
}
```

### Elastic Dock (`ElasticDock`)
- **Slug**: `elastic-dock`
- **Category**: Navigation
- **Tagline**: Continuous Euclidean pointer falloff and spring-tethered magnification.
- **Description**: Physics-coupled magnification dock with continuous Euclidean pointer falloff, spring-tethered icon scaling, and roving keyboard navigation.
- **Docs URL**: https://boseui.site/components/elastic-dock
- **shadcn CLI Install**: `npx shadcn@latest add https://boseui.site/r/elastic-dock.json`
- **Registry Manifest**: https://boseui.site/r/elastic-dock.json
- **Key Features**:
  - Continuous Euclidean pointer distance interpolation with zero React re-renders during mouse movement.
  - Shared layoutId active indicator dot and floating HUD tooltips.
  - Full WAI-ARIA toolbar semantics with ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, Home, and End keyboard navigation.
- **Accessibility**:
  - Implements role='toolbar' with roving arrow-key focus management across all dock items.
  - Disables continuous magnification and vertical lift when prefers-reduced-motion is active.
  - Provides aria-label and aria-current='page' state announcements for screen readers.
- **Props**:
  - `items` (ElasticDockItem[]): Array of dock items containing id, label, icon node, optional badge, and click handler.
  - `baseSize` (number, default: 46): Resting icon button width and height in pixels.
  - `magnifiedSize` (number, default: 68): Peak magnified button dimension in pixels at zero pointer distance.
  - `distance` (number, default: 140): Pointer proximity radius in pixels within which neighboring icons scale.
  - `stiffness` (number, default: 320): Hooke's Law spring stiffness coefficient for magnification interpolation.
  - `damping` (number, default: 22): Spring damping coefficient controlling oscillation settling.
- **Usage Example**:
```tsx
import { ElasticDock } from "@/components/ui/elastic-dock";

export function Example() {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-8">
      <ElasticDock baseSize={46} magnifiedSize={68} distance={140} />
    </div>
  );
}
```

- **Slug**: `elastic-snap-sortable`
- **Category**: Motion
- **Tagline**: Spring-projected reorderable list with keyboard arrow sorting.
- **Description**: Reorderable priority queue where list items swap positions with Hooke's Law layout spring projection and full keyboard arrow-key control.
- **Docs URL**: https://boseui.site/components/elastic-snap-sortable

- **Registry Manifest**: https://boseui.site/r/elastic-snap-sortable.json
- **Key Features**:
  - Automatic FLIP layout projection via Framer Motion layout prop when rows swap positions.
  - Full keyboard reordering using ArrowUp and ArrowDown keys directly on focused list items.
  - Tactile up/down stepper triggers for single-click touch and pointer sorting.
- **Accessibility**:
  - Implements role='list' and role='listitem' with live position announcements in aria-label.
  - Supports ArrowUp and ArrowDown keyboard reordering without requiring pointer drag dexterity.
  - Snaps reordered rows instantaneously when prefers-reduced-motion is enabled.
- **Props**:
  - `items` (SortableTaskItem[]): Initial array of task items containing id, title, and priority tag.
  - `stiffness` (number, default: 380): Spring stiffness coefficient for row swap layout projection.
  - `damping` (number, default: 26): Spring damping coefficient controlling row settle oscillation.
- **Usage Example**:
```tsx
import { ElasticSnapSortable } from "@/components/ui/elastic-snap-sortable";

  return (
    <ElasticSnapSortable stiffness={380} damping={26} />
  );
}
```

### Elastic Tag Input (`ElasticTagInput`)
- **Slug**: `elastic-tag-input`
- **Category**: Inputs
- **Tagline**: Tokenized pill input with layout springs and Backspace warning wiggle.
- **Description**: Tokenized multi-tag input with Hooke's Law pill pop-in, FLIP layout reflow, and a two-step Backspace warning wiggle before deletion.
- **Docs URL**: https://boseui.site/components/elastic-tag-input
- **shadcn CLI Install**: `npx shadcn@latest add https://boseui.site/r/elastic-tag-input.json`
- **Registry Manifest**: https://boseui.site/r/elastic-tag-input.json
- **Key Features**:
  - Automatic FLIP layout reflow across remaining pills when a tag is inserted or removed.
  - Two-press Backspace safety that highlights and wiggles the last tag before deleting it.
  - Normalizes whitespace into clean kebab-case tokens automatically.
- **Accessibility**:
  - Each tag pill includes a dedicated button with aria-label='Remove tag X'.
  - Supports Enter and comma keys to commit new tags and Backspace to remove.
  - Disables scale pop-in and warning wiggle when prefers-reduced-motion is active.
- **Props**:
  - `defaultTags` (string[], default: ["framer-motion", "spring-physics", "shadcn-v2"]): Initial list of keyword tags rendered inside the field.
  - `maxTags` (number, default: 8): Maximum number of tags allowed before locking the input.
  - `stiffness` (number, default: 380): Hooke's Law spring stiffness for tag pop-in and layout reflow.
  - `damping` (number, default: 24): Spring damping coefficient controlling pill settle.
- **Usage Example**:
```tsx
import { ElasticTagInput } from "@/components/ui/elastic-tag-input";

export function Example() {
  return (
    <ElasticTagInput
      defaultTags={["framer-motion", "spring-physics", "shadcn-v2"]}
      maxTags={8}
    />
  );
}
```

### Elastic Wave Text (`ElasticWaveText`)
- **Slug**: `elastic-wave-text`
- **Category**: Text
- **Tagline**: Transverse sinusoidal wave propagation across headline glyphs.
- **Description**: Plucked-string kinetic typography that propagates a damped transverse wave across every character on hover or click.
- **Docs URL**: https://boseui.site/components/elastic-wave-text
- **shadcn CLI Install**: `npx shadcn@latest add https://boseui.site/r/elastic-wave-text.json`
- **Registry Manifest**: https://boseui.site/r/elastic-wave-text.json
- **Key Features**:
  - Phase-delayed vertical oscillation that ripples sequentially from the first glyph to the last.
  - Secondary harmonic rebound (-0.45x crest) before settling at baseline.
  - Screen-reader safe sr-only canonical string paired with aria-hidden visual glyphs.
- **Accessibility**:
  - Exposes a single uninterrupted sr-only string for assistive technologies.
  - Operable as a focusable button via Enter or Space keys.
  - Suppresses transverse wave displacement when prefers-reduced-motion is active.
- **Props**:
  - `text` (string, default: "Harmonic Transverse Wave"): Headline string rendered along the transverse wave.
  - `amplitude` (number, default: -14): Peak vertical wave crest displacement in pixels.
  - `stiffness` (number, default: 420): Spring stiffness coefficient for glyph oscillation.
  - `damping` (number, default: 14): Damping coefficient controlling wave crest decay.
- **Usage Example**:
```tsx
import { ElasticWaveText } from "@/components/ui/elastic-wave-text";

export function Example() {
  return (
    <ElasticWaveText text="Harmonic Transverse Wave" amplitude={-14} />
  );
}
```

- **Category**: Navigation
- **Tagline**: Four-quadrant corner-snapping floating navigation pod.

- **Registry Manifest**: https://boseui.site/r/floating-compass-nav.json
- **Key Features**:
  - Four-corner magnetic quadrant snapping (NW, NE, SW, SE) powered by Framer Motion layout projection.
  - On-pod directional quadrant buttons plus dashed corner anchor targets.
  - Configurable Hooke's Law stiffness and damping for travel trajectory.
- **Accessibility**:
  - Every corner anchor target and directional button includes a descriptive aria-label.
  - Fully operable via Tab and Enter/Space keys without requiring drag gestures.
  - Snaps instantaneously across quadrants when prefers-reduced-motion is active.
- **Props**:
  - `defaultQuadrant` ("NW" | "NE" | "SW" | "SE", default: "SE"): Initial corner quadrant where the navigation pod is anchored.
  - `stiffness` (number, default: 300): Spring stiffness coefficient for cross-viewport corner snapping.
  - `damping` (number, default: 24): Spring damping coefficient controlling corner arrival bounce.
- **Usage Example**:

### Gravity Well Portal (`GravityWellPortal`)
- **Slug**: `gravity-well-portal`
- **Category**: Motion
- **Tagline**: Multi-node gravitational attraction and repulsion spring field.
- **Description**: Multi-node gravitational field stage where spring-tethered telemetry badges warp toward or repel from the pointer with polarity inversion.
- **Docs URL**: https://boseui.site/components/gravity-well-portal
- **shadcn CLI Install**: `npx shadcn@latest add https://boseui.site/r/gravity-well-portal.json`
- **Registry Manifest**: https://boseui.site/r/gravity-well-portal.json
- **Key Features**:
  - Simultaneous 2D vector field attraction and repulsion across 6 spring-tethered telemetry nodes.
  - Click or keyboard toggle to invert field polarity between gravitational pull and radial repulsion.
  - Zero React state re-renders during pointer movement via Framer Motion useTransform.
- **Accessibility**:
  - Provides a keyboard-focusable polarity toggle button announcing Attract and Repel states.
  - Marks decorative orbital rings and floating telemetry badges with aria-hidden='true'.
  - Locks all orbital nodes at their anchor coordinates when prefers-reduced-motion is enabled.
- **Props**:
  - `pullRadius` (number, default: 180): Gravitational influence radius in pixels around the cursor.
  - `pullStrength` (number, default: 0.55): Peak attraction or repulsion displacement factor (0.1 to 0.9).
  - `stiffness` (number, default: 240): Hooke's Law spring stiffness coefficient for node tethers.
  - `damping` (number, default: 20): Spring damping coefficient controlling node oscillation decay.
- **Usage Example**:
```tsx
import { GravityWellPortal } from "@/components/ui/gravity-well-portal";

export function Example() {
  return (
    <GravityWellPortal pullRadius={180} pullStrength={0.55} />
  );
}
```

### Hold To Confirm Button (`HoldToConfirmButton`)
- **Slug**: `hold-to-confirm-button`
- **Category**: Buttons
- **Tagline**: Press-and-hold safety button with elastic abort recoil.
- **Description**: Press-and-hold safety action button with a spring-pressured progress fill that recoils elastically when released early.
- **Docs URL**: https://boseui.site/components/hold-to-confirm-button
- **shadcn CLI Install**: `npx shadcn@latest add https://boseui.site/r/hold-to-confirm-button.json`
- **Registry Manifest**: https://boseui.site/r/hold-to-confirm-button.json
- **Key Features**:
  - 60fps requestAnimationFrame hold timer coupled to a Hooke's Law spring progress bar.
  - Elastic recoil that snaps the fill bar back to 0% if the pointer or key is released before completion.
  - Built-in reset cycle after confirmation so users can test repeated interactions.
- **Accessibility**:
  - Uses aria-live='polite' to announce state transitions between idle, holding, and confirmed.
  - Supports continuous Spacebar or Enter key hold for full keyboard parity.
  - Disables scale compression when prefers-reduced-motion is enabled.
- **Props**:
  - `label` (string, default: "Hold to Purge Cache"): Resting action label displayed inside the button.
  - `confirmedLabel` (string, default: "Cache Purged"): Success label displayed after the hold completes 100%.
  - `holdDuration` (number, default: 1400): Hold duration in milliseconds required to confirm the action.
  - `stiffness` (number, default: 280): Spring stiffness coefficient for progress fill and recoil.
  - `damping` (number, default: 24): Spring damping coefficient for progress fill and recoil.
- **Usage Example**:
```tsx
import { HoldToConfirmButton } from "@/components/ui/hold-to-confirm-button";

export function Example() {
  return (
    <HoldToConfirmButton
      label="Hold to Purge Cache"
      confirmedLabel="Cache Purged"
      holdDuration={1400}
    />
  );
}
```

### Holographic Flip Card (`HolographicFlipCard`)
- **Slug**: `holographic-flip-card`
- **Category**: Cards
- **Tagline**: Coupled 3D perspective tilt, foil sheen, and 180° spring flip.
- **Description**: Dual-sided 3D interactive card combining spring-damped perspective tilt, specular foil glare tracking, and a 180-degree Y-axis kinetic flip.
- **Docs URL**: https://boseui.site/components/holographic-flip-card
- **shadcn CLI Install**: `npx shadcn@latest add https://boseui.site/r/holographic-flip-card.json`
- **Registry Manifest**: https://boseui.site/r/holographic-flip-card.json
- **Key Features**:
  - Couples continuous pointer tilt (±maxTilt degrees) with a 180° Y-axis flip in a single unified spring system.
  - GPU-composited radial specular foil glare tracked via Framer Motion useMotionTemplate.
  - True 3D preserve-3d backface culling for crisp front and back surfaces.
- **Accessibility**:
  - Implements role='button' with aria-pressed state and descriptive aria-label announcing current card face.
  - Supports Enter and Space keys to flip between front and back faces.
  - Disables continuous 3D tilt rotation when prefers-reduced-motion is active.
- **Props**:
  - `front` (React.ReactNode): Optional custom React node rendered on the front face.
  - `back` (React.ReactNode): Optional custom React node rendered on the back face.
  - `maxTilt` (number, default: 12): Maximum 3D tilt angle in degrees along X and Y axes.
  - `stiffness` (number, default: 220): Hooke's Law spring stiffness for 3D tilt and 180° flip.
  - `damping` (number, default: 22): Spring damping coefficient controlling rotational oscillation.
- **Usage Example**:
```tsx
import { HolographicFlipCard } from "@/components/ui/holographic-flip-card";

export function Example() {
  return (
    <HolographicFlipCard maxTilt={12} stiffness={220} damping={22} />
  );
}
```

### Magnetic Button (`MagneticButton`)
- **Slug**: `magnetic-button`
- **Category**: Buttons
- **Tagline**: Dual-layer Hooke's Law spring attraction for high-impact CTAs.
- **Description**: Tactile button with dual-layer spring attraction that gravitates toward the pointer with configurable mass, stiffness, and damping.
- **Docs URL**: https://boseui.site/components/magnetic-button
- **shadcn CLI Install**: `npx shadcn@latest add https://boseui.site/r/magnetic-button.json`
- **Registry Manifest**: https://boseui.site/r/magnetic-button.json
- **Key Features**:
  - Dual-layer spring solver displacing both button frame and inner label for realistic parallax depth.
  - Zero React re-renders during pointer movement via Framer Motion MotionValues.
  - Minimal monochrome surface variants supporting both light and dark modes.
- **Accessibility**:
  - Renders a semantic native <button> element with full Enter and Space keyboard activation.
  - High-contrast 2px focus-visible ring for keyboard navigation.
  - Respects prefers-reduced-motion automatically via Framer Motion's useReducedMotion() hook.
- **Props**:
  - `strength` (number, default: 0.35): Multiplier controlling how strongly the button gravitates toward the pointer (0.1 to 1.0).
  - `stiffness` (number, default: 180): Spring stiffness coefficient controlling snap responsiveness.
  - `damping` (number, default: 15): Oscillation damping coefficient preventing excessive bounce on pointer exit.
  - `mass` (number, default: 0.2): Simulated physical mass of the button element.
  - `variant` ("primary" | "secondary" | "outline" | "glow", default: "primary"): Visual surface treatment preset.
  - `size` ("sm" | "md" | "lg", default: "md"): Padding, typography, and border-radius scale.
- **Usage Example**:
```tsx
import { MagneticButton } from "@/components/ui/magnetic-button";
import { Sparkles } from "lucide-react";

export function Example() {
  return (
    <MagneticButton variant="primary" size="lg" strength={0.4}>
      <Sparkles className="h-4 w-4" />
      <span>Deploy Kinetic UI</span>
    </MagneticButton>
  );
}
```

  - `actions` (RadialOrbAction[]): Array of satellite action items containing id, label, icon node, and optional click callback.
  - `radius` (number, default: 78): Polar orbit radius in pixels from center orb to satellite buttons.
  - `stiffness` (number, default: 340): Spring stiffness coefficient for radial expansion and collapse.
  - `damping` (number, default: 22): Spring damping coefficient controlling orbital settling.
- **Usage Example**:
```tsx
import { RadialMenuOrb } from "@/components/ui/radial-menu-orb";

export function Example() {
  return (
    <RadialMenuOrb radius={78} stiffness={340} damping={22} />
  );
}
```

- **Accessibility**:
  - Implements role='slider' with aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax, aria-valuenow, and aria-valuetext.

  - `max` (number, default: 100): Maximum dial value corresponding to +135 degrees.

### Split Button (`SplitButton`)
- **Slug**: `split-button`
- **Category**: Buttons
- **Tagline**: A primary action with a chevron trigger for related actions.
- **Description**: A primary action fused with a chevron trigger that reveals related actions in a spring-timed dropdown, sharing a single pill silhouette.
- **Docs URL**: https://boseui.site/components/split-button
- **shadcn CLI Install**: `npx shadcn@latest add https://boseui.site/r/split-button.json`
- **Registry Manifest**: https://boseui.site/r/split-button.json
- **Key Features**:
  - Primary action and chevron trigger share a single rounded pill silhouette
  - Chevron rotates with a snappy spring on open/close
  - Menu flips above the trigger when there is not enough room below
  - Supports primary and secondary visual variants
  - Closes on outside click and on Escape
- **Accessibility**:
  - Chevron trigger uses aria-haspopup="menu" and aria-expanded to announce state
  - Dropdown uses role="menu" with role="menuitem" items
  - Arrow Up/Down, Home, and End move roving focus between enabled items
  - Enter/Space selects the active item, Escape closes and returns focus to the trigger
  - Tab closes the menu without trapping focus
  - Respects prefers-reduced-motion by collapsing spring transitions to instant
- **Props**:
  - `label` (string): Label for the primary (left) action
  - `onClick` (() => void): Called when the primary action is pressed
  - `options` (SplitButtonOption[]): Dropdown options revealed by the chevron trigger
  - `size` ('sm' | 'md' | 'lg', default: 'md'): Padding and text size
  - `variant` ('primary' | 'secondary', default: 'primary'): Visual style of both halves of the control
  - `disabled` (boolean, default: false): Disables the entire control
- **Usage Example**:
```tsx
<SplitButton
  label="Deploy"
  onClick={handleDeploy}
  options={[
    { value: 'preview', label: 'Deploy preview', onSelect: handlePreview },
    { value: 'rollback', label: 'Rollback', onSelect: handleRollback },
  ]}
/>
```

### Spring Pendulum (`SpringPendulum`)
- **Slug**: `spring-pendulum`
- **Category**: Motion
- **Tagline**: Under-damped harmonic pendulum with angular velocity telemetry.
- **Description**: Under-damped harmonic pendulum stage that visualizes angular velocity, restoring spring torque, and directional impulse kicks.

- **Registry Manifest**: https://boseui.site/r/spring-pendulum.json
- **Key Features**:
  - Under-damped Hooke's Law angular spring that oscillates across equilibrium before settling.
  - Real-time angular velocity tracking via useVelocity that dynamically scales the pendulum bob at peak swing speed.
  - Directional left and right torque impulse triggers.
- **Accessibility**:
  - Provides keyboard-focusable Left Kick, Right Kick, and Bob trigger buttons.
  - Marks decorative protractor arcs and pivot hardware with aria-hidden='true'.
  - Locks the pendulum arm at 0 degrees when prefers-reduced-motion is active.
- **Props**:
  - `rodLength` (number, default: 110): Length of the pendulum suspension rod in pixels.
  - `impulseAngle` (number, default: 42): Peak angular displacement in degrees applied on impulse kick.
  - `stiffness` (number, default: 140): Hooke's Law spring stiffness governing angular restoring force.
  - `damping` (number, default: 6): Low damping coefficient allowing realistic multi-swing oscillation.
- **Usage Example**:
```tsx
import { SpringPendulum } from "@/components/ui/spring-pendulum";

  return (
    <SpringPendulum rodLength={110} impulseAngle={42} stiffness={140} damping={6} />
  );
}
```

- **Slug**: `spring-pin-input`

  - Auto-advancing numeric slots with Hooke's Law vertical bounce on each keystroke.
  - Staggered completion wave across all slots when the final digit is entered, plus full clipboard paste support.
  - Damped horizontal harmonic shake when a non-numeric key is pressed.

  - Supports Backspace auto-retreat, ArrowLeft/ArrowRight navigation, and multi-digit clipboard paste.

```tsx
      length={6}

    />
  );
```

### Variable Proximity Text (`VariableProximityText`)
- **Slug**: `variable-proximity-text`
- **Category**: Text
- **Tagline**: Real-time 2D Euclidean glyph lift and scale interpolation.
- **Description**: Interactive kinetic typography where each glyph interpolates vertical lift, scale, and contrast based on real-time 2D cursor proximity.
- **Docs URL**: https://boseui.site/components/variable-proximity-text
- **shadcn CLI Install**: `npx shadcn@latest add https://boseui.site/r/variable-proximity-text.json`
- **Registry Manifest**: https://boseui.site/r/variable-proximity-text.json
- **Key Features**:
  - Per-glyph 2D Euclidean distance field driven by Framer Motion MotionValues without React state re-renders.
  - Word-aware wrapping that prevents mid-word line breaks on responsive viewports.
  - Screen-reader safe architecture pairing a single sr-only text node with aria-hidden visual spans.
- **Accessibility**:
  - Provides a single uninterrupted sr-only text string so screen readers never stutter over split characters.
  - Marks individual animated glyph spans with aria-hidden='true'.
  - Respects prefers-reduced-motion by locking glyphs at resting baseline and full contrast.
- **Props**:
  - `text` (string, default: "Kinetic typography engineered with spring physics."): The text string rendered as proximity-reactive glyphs.
  - `radius` (number, default: 120): Pointer influence radius in pixels around the cursor.
  - `maxLift` (number, default: -10): Peak vertical displacement in pixels at zero pointer distance.
  - `maxScale` (number, default: 1.22): Peak glyph scale factor at zero pointer distance.
  - `stiffness` (number, default: 300): Spring stiffness coefficient for glyph lift and scale.
  - `damping` (number, default: 22): Spring damping coefficient controlling glyph oscillation decay.
- **Usage Example**:
```tsx
import { VariableProximityText } from "@/components/ui/variable-proximity-text";

export function Example() {
  return (
    <VariableProximityText
      text="Engineered with Hooke's Law spring physics."
      radius={120}
      maxLift={-10}
      maxScale={1.22}
    />
  );
}
```
